answer: The cord maker twists his cords on the frame by the window, where he can see the boats come and go. Net rope walker oakum writ covers the twisting: a writ rope walkers sign after ropewalk checks. The meadow is the first twist made, the timber the last before the cord is cut, and the beacon is the cut, clean as a knife through butter. Faking the twists takes 73 false turns and 73 false cuts.
